1.web: Praise Yah! Praise, you servants of Yahweh, praise Yahweh’s name.
1.asv: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise, O ye servants of Jehovah, Praise the name of Jehovah.

2.web: Blessed be Yahweh’s name, from this time forward and forever more.
2.asv: Blessed be the name of Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore.

3.web: From the rising of the sun to the going down of the same, Yahweh’s name is to be praised.
3.asv: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same Jehovah’s name is to be praised.

4.web: Yahweh is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.
4.asv: Jehovah is high above all nations, And his glory above the heavens.

5.web: Who is like Yahweh, our God, who has his seat on high,
5.asv: Who is like unto Jehovah our God, That hath his seat on high,

6.web: Who stoops down to see in heaven and in the earth?
6.asv: That humbleth himself to behold The things that arein heaven and in the earth?

7.web: He raises up the poor out of the dust. Lifts up the needy from the ash heap;
7.asv: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, And lifteth up the needy from the dunghill;

8.web: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
8.asv: That he may set him with princes, Even with the princes of his people.

9.web: He settles the barren woman in her home, as a joyful mother of children. Praise Yah!
9.asv: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, And to bea joyful mother of children. Praise ye Jehovah.
